baseline.kind: in-process slow HTTP fakes with incident meeting and existing Research ticket fixture

implementation.owner_deadline: One absolute deadline computed before either owner starts: min(parent deadline, start + 0.8 * human_inbox_surface_timeout_seconds()).
implementation.parallelism: Submit Research first using submit_owner_read (copied caller context), then execute the existing concurrent consultation reads. Both use that absolute deadline.
implementation.collection: Research and consultation waits are bounded by the remaining common deadline. Late results stay in their futures and never modify the response.
unchanged_boundaries: Other inbox contributors and their caps
Owner authorization, tenant checks, private evidence filtering and pagination

runtime_budget.cadence: On demand, one meetings contributor per admitted human inbox request; no recurring job.
runtime_budget.hosted_scale: The existing global inbox admission permits four concurrent requests per BFF process. Each uses up to three consultation GETs and one Research GET.
runtime_budget.threads: Existing consultation pool: 12 workers and 12 nonblocking slots. Added shared Research pool: 4 workers and 4 nonblocking slots per BFF process; no executor per request and no unbounded pending queue.
runtime_budget.count_cap: At most 16 in-flight owner reads per BFF process (12 consultation, 4 Research), including late transports. Slots release only when their future finishes or is cancelled.
runtime_budget.size: Existing pages remain capped at 100 meetings and 100 Research tickets; existing Research response limit remains 4 MiB. No new persisted payload.
runtime_budget.growth_per_day: 0 persistent bytes, files, rows or jobs; fixed pools reuse threads.
runtime_budget.cleanup: Request futures/results are released after collection; late futures only hold their own data until completion. Slots release via done callbacks. Shared pool threads end with the BFF process.
runtime_budget.writers: No new persistent writer, cache, workflow input or job. This fixed task evidence file is source documentation only.

assertion_changes: Socket timeout and remaining-budget bounds increase 0.4 -> 0.8 because both owners share the former two sequential 40% phases.
The consultation late fake increases 0.5 -> 0.9 seconds so it still exceeds the owner deadline; response bound increases 0.48 -> 0.88 seconds and stays below the unchanged 1.0 second surface cap.
Surface-cap parametrization is retained; expected owner fraction increases 0.4 -> 0.8 and the test name describes the new shared phases.
The existing 30-read consultation test keeps its 0.4 second elapsed assertion and its three-party barrier. No existing test removed or disabled.
